scenario.orbit: 50 x 300 km polar, perilune start, uniform rotation

expanded_force_control.interpretation: Earth/Sun/SRP are common deterministic forces, not an error floor; policy errors are measured against an N=300 run with the same forces.

orbit.source_scope: LRO commissioning-orbit design geometry; not a new differential correction

scenario.qualification: LRO-like quasi-frozen design geometry control, not a validated frozen-family discovery
scenario.cost_match_definition: nearest integer fixed degree to sqrt(mean N^2) of the archived matching schedule; wall time is reported separately

scenario.energy_definition: specific E = |v|^2/2 - U_N; piecewise U_N for the switch

source_notes.LRO_geometry: Mesarch et al., AAS 23-238 / NASA NTRS 20230010945: 30 x 216 km, i approximately 90 deg, AOP approximately 270 deg.
source_notes.scope: The four controls test numerical robustness and one published quasi-frozen design geometry; they do not establish a universal scheduling theorem.
